name: Ray Fisher
bio:
Ray Fisher (born September 8, 1987) is an American actor. He is known for portraying the superhero Victor Stone / Cyborg in the DC Extended Universe media franchise, including Justice League (2017). In television, he played roles in the third season of the crime drama series True Detective in 2019 and the limited series Women of the Movement in 2022. He made his Broadway debut in the 2022 revival of the play The Piano Lesson and has also starred in its 2024 film adaptation.
